reported.title: ADC conversion uses 5000 mV reference instead of 1100 mV
reported.description: analogRead is scaled with 5000/1023 but the LM35 output is only ~0.18–0.22 V, so the computed temperature is ~4.5x too high (e.g. 20 °C reads ~91 °C), keeping the heater permanently OFF. Use the internal 1.1 V reference (analogReference(INTERNAL)) and scale by 1100/1023.

reported.title: Integer division truncates millivolt reading
reported.description: analogRead(TEMP_PIN) * 5000 / 1023 is integer arithmetic; with the correct 1100 mV reference the product still fits, but the truncation to whole millivolts loses resolution and the expression must be evaluated in a wider/float type to avoid truncation errors near the band edges.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when A0 < 18; LOW when A0 > 22; within 600 ms (Heat below 18, off above 22)

judge_input.spec:
- Cabin LM35 on A0 at 10 mV/°C; heater enable on D9; frost override on D2 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Turn the heater ON when temperature is below 18.0 °C and OFF when temperature is above 22.0 °C.
- While D2 is held LOW, force the heater ON regardless of temperature.
- Reach the commanded heater state within 600 ms of a sustained band crossing.
- Print `cabin: <temp> C heat=ON` or `cabin: <temp> C heat=OFF` every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Temperature in the status line is informational; control decisions use the comfort band above.
